"""
===========
validate.py
===========

:summary:
    Performs input validation for the provided configuration file.
    This module contains functions for validating each section of a
    configuration file. This is namely used for identifying invalid input
    and outlining the errors to the user, before faults can occur later,
    i.e. during long simulations. Functions in this module will not return
    anything on valid input, but may throw errors or raise warnings on
    invalid input.

:author:
    Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk

:version:
    0.0.0 - Skeleton class awaiting implementation.
"""

import nav_toolbox.input.defaults as default

from nav_toolbox.input.config_handler import ConfigHandler
from nav_toolbox.input.config_handler import NavConfigError




[docs]
def validate_all(config: ConfigHandler):
    """
    Performs validation for all sections of a configuration file.
    This is a shorthand method that saves calling all validation
    functions independently.

    :param config: The ConfigHandler instance to perform validation for.
    :type config: ConfigHandler
    """
    validate_output_section(config)
    validate_waypoint_section(config)
    validate_vehicle_section(config)
    validate_measurement_section(config)
    validate_estimation_section(config)
    validate_racetrack_section(config)

def validate_waypoint_section(config: ConfigHandler):
    """
    Performs validation for the waypoint section of a configuration file.

    :param config: The ConfigHandler instance to perform validation for.
    :type config: ConfigHandler
    """

    if config.get_value_float("Waypoints", "maxTime", default.MAX_TIME) <= 0:
        raise NavConfigError(
            "Waypoints", "maxTime", "Must Be Positive",
            "The maximum time must be a positive numerical value")
